sentences.text: CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE H.C. MISHRA
For the Petitioner : Mr. Ram Chanddra Prasad Sah

For the State : A. P.P.
 -----
 4/15.01.2016 Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.
The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with G.O. Case No.208 of 2014, for the alleged offences under Sections 26(i), 2(i), 27, 48 and 59(iii) of Food Safety and Standard Act.
Petitioner is the owner of a hotel and he has been made accused in this case for using haldi powder of a particular brand, which was found to be unsafe.
It is admitted by both the parties that haldi powder was being used in the food prepared in the hotel of the petitioner.
In the facts and circumstances of the case, I am inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

Accordingly, it is directed that in the event of surrender / arrest, the petitioner Sumesh Kumar Singh Deo shall be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (Ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount of each to the satisfaction of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Saraikella, in connection with G.O. Case No.208 of 2014, subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
